ip_locked_title: Only pushes from the allowed CIDRs are accepted
sync_no_result: {{label}} on {{device}}: no result after 3 minutes — check the server log

menu.sync_attendance_na: Not applicable — this terminal pushes punches up by itself, including anything it buffered while offline.
menu.write_lcd_na: Not available — the access-control protocol has no command for writing to the screen.
menu.unlock_door_acc: Queued — the door opens when the terminal next polls, usually within ~10s, not instantly.
menu.clear_attendance_acc: This will permanently wipe the access-control records held on the terminal. Records already synced to the database are kept. The command is queued and runs when the terminal next polls — nothing is deleted at the moment you confirm.
menu.clear_attendance_att: This will permanently wipe attendance logs from the device memory. Records already synced to the database are kept.
menu.restart_acc: The terminal will reboot. The command is queued and runs when it next polls, so it will not restart at the moment you confirm. It goes offline briefly and reconnects automatically.
menu.restart_att: The device will reboot. It will go offline briefly and reconnect automatically.

open_pairing_title: Briefly accept serials this server has never seen, so they can be approved
waiting_approval_hint: These serials contacted the server but push nothing until approved.
revocations_banner_title: Access revocations are waiting to reach a door
revocations_banner_body: These people have been removed in the system but the terminal has not collected and confirmed it, so they can still get in. A device that is offline will not collect anything until it comes back.
empty: No devices registered yet. Add one to get started.
revocations_not_confirmed_one: {{count}} revocation not confirmed at this door
revocations_not_confirmed_other: {{count}} revocations not confirmed at this door
edit_timezone_title: Change what this device's punch times mean
pinned_title: Manually set — pinned against automatic reclassification until the device sends contradicting evidence
edit_protocol_title: Correct which PUSH protocol this device is treated as speaking
